metadata.title: Chevron Strikes Power Deal With Microsoft for West Texas AI Data Center - WSJ

content.text:
Chevron CVX 0.82%increase; up pointing triangle has struck a 20-year agreement to sell electricity to Microsoft MSFT -3.18%decrease; down pointing triangle, which plans to build what could become one of the country’s largest artificial-intelligence data centers in West Texas.
The oil company is working with Joulent, an energy company launched by investment firm Engine No. 1, to build a massive power-generation complex that will supply the data center using natural gas produced from the company’s fields in the area. The 2.7-gigawatt campus would be on more than 2,000 acres in Reeves County in the heart of the Permian Basin oil-and-gas field, according to Joulent.
